data.name: ExplainLeca
data.value: Fired clay balls. With water in the bottom of the pot, they wick it up to the roots, with no soil. This is called semi-hydro.
data.comment: Explains what LECA is, under the choice of medium.

data.name: ExplainPon
data.value: A ready-made mix of mineral grains like pumice, zeolite and lava rock, used for semi-hydro in place of soil.
data.comment: Explains what PON is, under the choice of medium.

data.name: ExplainSphagnum
data.value: Long-fibred moss that holds a lot of water and still lets air in. Often used to root cuttings.
data.comment: Explains what sphagnum moss is, under the choice of medium.

data.name: ExplainCormRiser
data.value: The corm sits on a raised layer above water in a closed box, so it stays damp without sitting in water.
data.comment: Explains what a corm riser is, under the choice of medium.

data.name: ExplainAirLayer
data.value: Roots are grown on a stem while it's still on the plant, in damp moss wrapped round it, and it's cut off once they're there.
data.comment: Explains what an air layer is, under the choice of propagation type.
